It does not diagnose, prescribe or replace your provider.
It is not emergency care. In an emergency, call 911.
Your health data stays private and is never sold.

terms.title: Terms & Disclaimer
body: Your Oracle Clinician provides general health education based on the published work of Deborah Maragopoulos FNP. It is not medical advice, diagnosis or treatment.
Always talk with a qualified provider before making decisions about your health, medications or treatment. Never ignore professional advice or delay seeking it because of something you read here.
If you think you may have a medical emergency, call 911 or go to the nearest emergency room immediately.

privacy.title: How your health data is protected
body: We treat everything you share as protected health information under HIPAA, CCPA and CMIA.
Your conversations are never used to train AI models without your explicit consent.
Notifications on your lock screen never show symptoms, conditions or product names.
You can download or delete your data at any time from Account › Privacy & data.

profileConsent.title: Before we set up {name}’s profile

child.body: Profiles for children under 13 are set up and managed by a parent or legal guardian. Their information stays in your account, and you can delete it at any time.
child.check: I am {name}’s parent or legal guardian

teen.body: Profiles for teens aged 13 to 17 come with extra privacy protections. The exact rules are still being finalised, and we’ll explain them before anything changes.
teen.check: I am {name}’s parent or legal guardian, and {name} knows I’m setting this up

adult.body: {name} is an adult, so their health information belongs to them. Only add them if they’ve agreed.
